prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
ai_overview_text:
You can choose from several local and East Bay-based personal injury and car accident law firms serving Pleasanton, California:
Law Offices of O'Connor, Runckel & O'Malley: Handles automobile, motorcycle, and catastrophic injury cases in Alameda County with free consultations. O'Connor, Runckel & O'Malley LLP
Stephen M. Fuerch (Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch): A local trial attorney in Pleasanton with over 35 to 40 years of experience, including background in insurance defense. Stephen M. Fuerch +1
Venardi Zurada LLP: Represents motor vehicle and crash victims in Pleasanton and the Bay Area on a contingency-fee basis. Venardi Zurada
Mirador Law: Located on Willow Road in Pleasanton ((925) 460-8484), handling Alameda County civil and auto injury claims. Mirador Law
The Jagroop Law Office, Inc.: Bay Area vehicle accident lawyers offering 24/7 support and free consultations (510-556-4013). The Jagroop Law Office, Inc.
Thomas E. Sokat Personal Injury Law Firm: Serves Pleasanton clients with lower contingency fee structures (typically 25% to 33% instead of standard higher rates). www.tomsokatlaw.com
Cost: Most car accident lawyers in California work on a contingency fee (usually 33% to 40%), meaning you pay no upfront costs and only pay if they recover money for you. Gerald L. Marcus
Deadline: Under California law (CCP § 335.1), you generally have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit. Ben Crump - Trial Lawyer for Justice
Fault: California uses a pure comparative negligence rule, meaning your compensation can be reduced by your percentage of fault if you share any blame. www.tomsokatlaw.com
How severe are your injuries and property damage?
Have you already spoken with any insurance adjusters?
